title: A1 - Getting started with ALprekDB
text: Real-data examples run private project. Keep paths environment variables, keep row-level outputs GitHub, keep student PII/date--birth fields excluded unless controlled analysis explicitly requires . Process one module first, inspect validation object, expand full multi-module workflow: linked private analysis, use multi-year processing helpers even starting single year. keeps object classes consistent larger panel workflows.
code: data_dir <- Sys.getenv("ALPREKDB_DATA_DIR")  budget_cfg <- budget_config(   school_year = "2024-2025",   budget_path = file.path(data_dir, "budget_2024_2025.xlsx") )  classroom_cfg <- classroom_config(   school_year = "2024-2025",   classroom_path = file.path(data_dir, "classroom_2024_2025.xlsx"),   include_dob = FALSE )  student_cfg <- student_config(   school_year = "2024-2025",   path = file.path(data_dir, "student_2024_2025.xlsx"),   include_pii = FALSE ) budget_result <- budget_process(budget_cfg, export = FALSE) budget_result$validation budget_result$long budget_result$master  classroom_result <- classroom_process(classroom_cfg, export = FALSE) classroom_result$validation  student_result <- student_process(student_cfg, export = FALSE) student_result$validation budget_panel <- budget_process_years(list(budget_cfg), export = FALSE)$panel classroom_panel <- classroom_process_years(list(classroom_cfg), export = FALSE)$panel student_panel <- student_process_years(list(student_cfg), export = FALSE)$panel  master <- linkage_create_master(   budget = budget_panel,   classroom = classroom_panel,   student = student_panel )  linkage_validate(master) linkage_summary_stats(master)

code: template_dir <- system.file("templates", "targets", package = "ALprekDB")  dir.create("alprekdb-private-workflow", showWarnings = FALSE) file.copy(   list.files(template_dir, full.names = TRUE, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE),   "alprekdb-private-workflow",   recursive = TRUE ) export ALPREKDB_RUN_REALDATA=1 export ALPREKDB_DATA_DIR="/path/to/local/ADECE/source/files" export ALPREKDB_OUTPUT_DIR="output/alprekdb" export ALPREKDB_WRITE_OUTPUTS=1

title: A2 - Build Panels
text: ALprekDB builds three panel objects linkage: budget panel one row per classroom-year funding record; classroom panel one row per classroom-year site/classroom record; student panel one row per student-year record. v0.6.0, real-data source scope intentionally asymmetric: vignette uses synthetic data executable examples. private real-data snippets show object contract without exposing raw ADECE files.

title: A2 - Build Panels
text: synthetic generators return panel objects directly. useful learning package structure testing analysis code, estimating Alabama program quantities. Generated classroom identifiers use fake 9xx prefixes synthetic county labels keep public printed output visibly separate confidential ADECE rows. synthetic setup deliberately gives budget two years classroom/student three years. mirrors real v0.6.0 lesson: later classroom/student year can retained even budget coverage unavailable.
code: n_classrooms <- 12 n_students <- 60 seed <- 42  budget_panel <- alprek_synthetic_budget(   n_classrooms = n_classrooms,   n_years = 2,   seed = seed )  classroom_panel <- alprek_synthetic_classroom(   n_classrooms = n_classrooms,   n_years = 3,   seed = seed )  student_panel <- alprek_synthetic_student(   n_students = n_students,   n_classrooms = n_classrooms,   n_years = 3,   seed = seed )  budget_panel #> <alprek_budget_panel> #>   Years: 2021-2022, 2022-2023  #>   Total rows: 24  #>      2021-2022 : 12 classrooms ( legacy ) #>      2022-2023 : 12 classrooms ( legacy ) classroom_panel #> <alprek_classroom_panel> #>   Years: 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024  #>   Total observations: 36  #>   Columns: 44  #>      2021-2022 : 12 classrooms ( legacy ) #>      2022-2023 : 12 classrooms ( legacy ) #>      2023-2024 : 12 classrooms ( legacy ) student_panel #> <alprek_student_panel> #>   Years: 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024  #>   Total observations: 180  #>   Unique students: 180  #>   Columns: 145  #>      2021-2022 : 60 students ( legacy , 145 cols) #>      2022-2023 : 60 students ( legacy , 145 cols) #>      2023-2024 : 60 students ( legacy , 145 cols)

title: A2 - Build Panels
text: Every panel object $data table $years vector. Module-specific metadata differs slightly. main difference budget panels expose $n_years, classroom student panels expose $n_total. Classroom panels also carry $imputation_log; student panels carry $n_unique_students.
code: panel_anatomy <- function(x, module) {   data.frame(     module = module,     class = paste(class(x), collapse = ", "),     fields = paste(names(x), collapse = ", "),     years = paste(as.character(x$years), collapse = ", "),     rows = nrow(x$data),     columns = ncol(x$data),     stringsAsFactors = FALSE   ) }  rbind(   panel_anatomy(budget_panel, "budget"),   panel_anatomy(classroom_panel, "classroom"),   panel_anatomy(student_panel, "student") ) #>      module                  class #> 1    budget    alprek_budget_panel #> 2 classroom alprek_classroom_panel #> 3   student   alprek_student_panel #>                                             fields #> 1                    data, years, n_years, by_year #> 2    data, years, n_total, by_year, imputation_log #> 3 data, years, n_total, n_unique_students, by_year #>                             years rows columns #> 1            2021-2022, 2022-2023   24      38 #> 2 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024   36      44 #> 3 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024  180     145

title: A7: Geocoding Quality
text: geocode module (added v0.8.0) reconciles two coordinate sources Alabama First Class Pre-K site: Melissa.com — commercial geocoding vendor (delivered 29-column Excel file release cycle). Melissa returns site latitude / longitude plus RESULTCODE describing precision tier every lookup. ADECE — administrative coordinates ADECE staff maintain internal classroom data (carried alprek_classroom_panel’s latitude / longitude columns). sources known weaknesses. Melissa can fall back ZIP centroid address unparseable. ADECE coordinates can drift site moves original entry Google-Maps--iPhone tap rather careful rooftop pin. geocode module’s job pick one authoritative coordinate per site-year, explain , flag rows need analyst follow-. vignette walks pipeline end--end synthetic data (alprek_synthetic_geocode()), every chunk runs without ADECE/Melissa file. Real-data calls look identical — just point geocode_read() actual Melissa .xlsx. module follows shape every ALprekDB module: read -> detect -> clean -> validate -> reconcile -> transform -> panel -> export -> linkage -> DuckDB persistence.

title: A7: Geocoding Quality
text: design, module-level production panels output/budget/, output/classroom/, output/student/, output/applications/ carry geocode columns. ALprekDB keeps cleaning validation strictly module-local: panel canonical output one cleaning pipeline. Joining geocode panel analyst’s choice, exercised analysis time using package’s linkage_*() functions. benefit straight separation concerns: budget cleaning bug never wait geocoding rebuild, analysts need different cycle Melissa data can swap freely. Four common patterns follow. 2-4 lines code. Pattern — Classroom + geocode. Direct join (site_code, school_year). Adds 12 prefixed geocode_* columns classroom panel. Pattern B — Applications + geocode. Two-phase join: matched_site_code renewals (buckets /B/C) row_id bucket-D “truly new” applications whose _new_NNNN row_ids correspond directly Melissa rows. Pattern C — Budget / student panels. Budget classroom_code (site_code), linkage_create_master() handles indirect resolution. Student student-year grain; geocode value propagated via classroom join inside master integrator. Pattern D — Full integrated master. call produced output/master/master_classroom_level_2026-2027_v0.8.0.csv v0.8.0 release packet; rerun locally inspect alongside panels. geocode panel can loaded v0.8.0 release artifact rebuilt Melissa xlsx; flows equivalent.

ALprekDB modular R package ADECE budget, classroom, student records. handles file-format detection, data-driven codebooks, validation diagnostics, derived student variables, cross-module linkage, DuckDB storage, export helpers. title: Generate Synthetic Geocoded Master Data — alprek_synthetic_geocode
text: n_sites Integer. Number distinct sites (renewal pattern). Default 50L. Sites stable across years (row_id, site_code, site_name repeated). n_years Integer. Number school years span. Default 3L. -recent year cycle_year_anchor panel extends backward. Total rows = n_sites * n_years (plus small "_new" cohort n_years >= 4). share_missing_adece Numeric 0 1, inclusive. Default 0.10 (deliberately higher v0.8.0 empirical ~5.4% synthetic signal unambiguous tests). share_missing_site_code Numeric 0 1, inclusive. Share rows site_code NA (_new cohort pattern). Default 0.03. share_high_resultcode_agreement Numeric 0 1, inclusive. Share rows assigned RESULTCODE == "GS05" (rooftop, high agreement quality). remainder split across c("GS06", "GS03", "GS01") v0.8.0 empirical ratios. Default 0.7. edge_case Character NULL. non-NULL, must one "G01".."G18"; function returns package-internal fixture's $data tibble. what: Reconcile ADECE Applications Against Prior Classroom Panel — applications_reconcile
title: Reconcile ADECE Applications Against Prior Classroom Panel — applications_reconcile
text: Assigns cycle-1 application row (renewals + new) one four buckets records every match decision (exact, fuzzy automatic, match) plus top-3 fuzzy candidates considered. Solves Gap #1 2026-05 ad-hoc cycle (automatic match decisions logged). Buckets: - renewal row, exact key match prior_classroom_panel (organization, prior project name, county). Carries matched classroom_code. B - renewal row, exact match, fuzzy (Jaro-Winkler) similarity >= fuzzy_threshold. Carries best-match classroom_code, flagged analyst review. C - new-application row whose fuzzy similarity prior classroom >= fuzzy_threshold (probably additional classroom existing program). Carries best-match classroom_code, flagged. D - candidate >= fuzzy_threshold. Treated truly new; downstream geocoding + isochrone packages take . geocoding, ACS integration, Bayesian modelling - live separate packages.

text: Standardizes column names, dtypes, value formatting alprek_geocode_raw object downstream geocoding steps (geocode_validate(), geocode_reconcile()) can operate stable contract. 11-step pipeline (order) : Apply column map (rename needed per alprek_geocode_column_map(); v1 names unchanged). Coerce Melissa LAT / LNG character numeric. key transformation. Coercion failures logged. Defensively coerce ADECE latitude / longitude numeric. Coerce ERRORCODE logical character. (readxl parses -NA columns logical — standardize character future deliveries populate ERRORCODE compose schema.) Keep ZIP-family fields character. site_zip parsed numeric readxl numeric column; convert character preserve leading zeros . GEOZIP / PLUS4 / DPB already character trimmed defensively. Standardize school_year: trim, validate canonical set {2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024-2025, 2025-2026_new}. Unknown values logged severity WARN. Title-case COUNTYNAME (Melissa returns -CAPS). Cross-validate alprek_geocode_al_fips_counties(); unrecognized AL county names logged severity WARN. Trim whitespace character columns. Defensively coerce has_latlon logical. Attach data_source_map attribute labels column provenance group: id/adece -> "ADECE", melissa_norm/melissa_out -> "Melissa-". Drop lock-file artifact rows ~$*.xlsx rows leaked data (defensive). raw_row_index lineage_id preserved unchanged.

what: Compare Two Melissa Geocode Deliveries — geocode_compare_deliveries
title: Compare Two Melissa Geocode Deliveries — geocode_compare_deliveries
text: Compares two Melissa-returned geocoded xlsx deliveries end--end: schema (column set, dtypes, possible renames), enum value sets, row-level changes (additions, removals, value updates), _new-placeholder → assigned-site_code resolution pairs. Returns structured alprek_geocode_delivery_diff object caller can inspect manually hand printer one-paragraph summary. verdict ("compatible", "compatible_with_additions", "breaking") follows Step 1.4 format-diff protocol: schema breaking changes, duplicate row_ids either file, sheet rename always escalate "breaking"; otherwise delivery "compatible" neither value sets rows changed, else "compatible_with_additions".

title: Compare Two Melissa Geocode Deliveries — geocode_compare_deliveries
code: geocode_compare_deliveries(   path_old,   path_new,   sheet = "Sheet1",   rename_jw_threshold = 0.85,   join_key = "row_id",   enum_cols = c("school_year", "RESULTCODE", "STATUSCODE", "COUNTYNAME", "FIPS",     "PLACENAME"),   change_cols = c("site_code", "latitude", "longitude", "LAT", "LNG", "geocode_address",     "site_street", "COUNTYNAME", "RESULTCODE"),   verbose = FALSE )

title: Compare Two Melissa Geocode Deliveries — geocode_compare_deliveries
text: path_old, path_new Character. Paths two delivery xlsx files. must exist. sheet Character. Sheet name read files. Default "Sheet1". requested sheet absent either file triggers verdict = "breaking". rename_jw_threshold Numeric [0, 1]. Default 0.85. Greedy 1--1 column-rename pairing requires Jaro-Winkler similarity least large. Higher = stricter pairing. join_key Character. Column join row-level comparison. Default "row_id". enum_cols Character vector. Columns whose distinct value sets inspect. Default c("school_year", "RESULTCODE", "STATUSCODE", "COUNTYNAME", "FIPS", "PLACENAME"). change_cols Character vector. Columns whose row-level values diff. Default c("site_code", "latitude", "longitude", "LAT", "LNG", "geocode_address", "site_street", "COUNTYNAME", "RESULTCODE"). verbose Logical. Print progress messages? Default FALSE.

title: Compare Two Melissa Geocode Deliveries — geocode_compare_deliveries
text: alprek_geocode_delivery_diff S3 list elements: $meta — list input paths, SHA-256 hashes, sheet names, dimensions deliveries, computed timestamp. $schema_diff — tibble (one row per column) statuses "in_both", "dtype_changed", "possible_rename", "added", "removed". $value_set_diff — tibble (one row per (column, value)) statuses "in_both", "added", "removed". $rows_only_old, $rows_only_new — tibbles row_ids one delivery, augmented likely_replaced_by / likely_replaces _new ↔ resolved pair found. $rows_changed — tibble per-row, per-column changes (NA--= unchanged; NA-vs-value = changed). $row_id_replaced_pairs — tibble _new → assigned-site_code row_id resolutions detected via (school_year_root, site_name, geocode_address). $summary — tibble (metric, value) headline counters. $verdict — one "compatible", "compatible_with_additions", "breaking". $verdict_reasons — character vector reason strings driving verdict.

what: Detect Melissa Geocode File Format — geocode_detect_format
title: Detect Melissa Geocode File Format — geocode_detect_format
text: Inspects column names Melissa-returned geocoded delivery decides whether matches v1 contract (format = "melissa_v1_2026") unrecognized (format = "unknown"). Reports confidence score [0, 1] set input columns v1 contract. Used geocode_read() (upstream gate) geocode_compare_deliveries() (label delivery's format diffing). Mirrors role applications_detect_format() budget_detect_format() respective modules. Detection logic: Marker columns (must present): row_id, LAT, LNG, RESULTCODE. Absence marker → format = "unknown", confidence = 0. Exact match 29 v1 columns (case-sensitive) → confidence = 1. Markers present v1 columns missing extra → confidence interpolated Jaccard similarity: |input ∩ v1| / |input ∪ v1|. Threshold: confidence >= 0.5 markers present → format = "melissa_v1_2026". Otherwise "unknown".

what: Reconcile ADECE and Melissa Geocoded Coordinates (Step 4.3) — geocode_reconcile
title: Reconcile ADECE and Melissa Geocoded Coordinates (Step 4.3) — geocode_reconcile
text: Applies LOCKED 15-cell decision matrix Step 4.2 cleaned Melissa-returned geocoded dataset. site row, picks authoritative (lat, lng) pair, records precision tier, computes ADECE<->Melissa distance (sources present), assigns coordinate-agreement band, flags rows need analyst followup. Every decision logged reconciliation_log matrix cell ID downstream consumers (Step 4.4 followup queue, Step 4.5 sanity tests) can audit single-row decision without re-running reconciler. Decision-matrix scope (Step 4.2 LOCKED): D1-D9 – sources present; outcome driven RESULTCODE (GS01/GS05/GS06), per-tier threshold, gross-outlier check (>=10 km). D10 – sources present, RESULTCODE == GS03, distance: disputed_melissa (centroid unreliable; flag followup). D11 – ADECE (Melissa unexpectedly missing): use ADECE, flag. D12 – Melissa (GS01/GS05): use Melissa, OK (Melissa authoritative geocode source rows). D13 – Melissa (GS06, interpolated rooftop): use Melissa, flag analyst review. D14 – Melissa (GS03, ZIP centroid): use Melissa, flag. D15 – missing: coordinate; flag both_missing. matrix can inverted priority level via config$authoritative_priority == "adece_first", case D1-D9 resolve ADECE-anchored decisions (still flagged distances exceed per-tier threshold). Tier thresholds come config$tiered_thresholds (default list(GS01 = 50, GS05 = 250, GS06 = 500, GS03 = Inf)). reconciler never hardcodes RESULTCODE -> precision_tier; looks alprek_geocode_resultcode_meaning() future codebook updates flow without code changes. acceptable_for_master codebook also enforced: unacceptable unknown RESULTCODE values retained analyst review flagged marked not_model_ready.

Rows outside cycle year retain master's pre-application schema application-context columns left NA / FALSE. Order operations. budget -> student aggregates -> classroom-level master (derived per-child/per-seat budget) -> optional geocode join -> optional applications join. geocode join runs first bucket-D applications (site_code yet) can later wired reconciled coordinates via applications path.

text: release adds new geocode module integrating commercial-grade Melissa.com address-geocoding deliveries existing classroom applications modules. module follows architecture budget, classroom, student, applications modules. New R source files implement full pipeline: R/geocode-config.R, R/geocode-codebooks.R, R/geocode-read.R, R/geocode-detect.R, R/geocode-clean.R, R/geocode-validate.R, R/geocode-reconcile.R, R/geocode-transform.R, R/geocode-panel.R, R/geocode-export.R, R/utils-geo.R, R/linkage-geocode.R, R/db-geocode.R, R/data-synthetic-geocode.R (14 files total). geocode_read() ingests Melissa delivery workbooks captures file SHA-256, git SHA, receipt date, sheet, per-row raw_row_index, stable per-row lineage_id. geocode_detect_format() distinguishes Melissa delivery variants marker columns. geocode_compare_deliveries() produces delivery--delivery diff (row count, column drift, coordinate movement) future Melissa runs can reviewed documented baseline. geocode_clean() standardizes columns via geocode_column_map_melissa_v1 codebook parses Melissa RESULTCODE / STATUSCODE / ERRORCODE multi-value strings validated character vectors. geocode_validate() runs 15 base data-contract checks including codebook-driven RESULTCODE STATUSCODE membership, Alabama FIPS-county membership, coordinate ranges. Validation uses structured ERROR / WARN / INFO severity, row-level $issues accumulation, fixture-backed regression tests. geocode_reconcile() partitions every Melissa row ADECE classroom coordinates using documented decision matrix (Decision §11.x): accept Melissa, retain ADECE, retain , flag follow-. geocode_followup_queue() extracts rows manual review attaches privacy attributes site_street contains full PII-sensitive addresses. geocode_transform() derives coord_model_status (model-readiness gate) run-level variables new alprek_geocode_master S3 object. geocode_bind_years() stacks multiple Melissa runs alprek_geocode_panel. Adds four new DuckDB tables share existing _alprek_column_types registry. alprek_synthetic_geocode() generates synthetic Melissa-shaped geocode rows vignettes, examples, tests using fake-code conventions synthetic generators. alprek_haversine_m() computes great-circle distances meters coordinate pairs (used reconciliation tests). title: ALprekDB 0.7.0 (2026-05-19)
text: release adds new applications module processing ADECE annual classroom-applications workbook (renewals, new applications, non-renewals, per-site capacity). module follows architecture existing budget, classroom, student modules. New read functions four input kinds: applications_read_renewals(), applications_read_new(), applications_read_nonrenewal(), applications_read_capacity(). captures file SHA-256, git SHA, receipt date, sheet, per-row raw_row_index, stable per-row lineage_id downstream tracing. applications_detect_format() distinguishes cycle-1 (2026-2027) cycle-0 (2025-2026) formats marker columns. applications_clean() standardizes columns via codebook column maps (one per kind per cycle), parses currency-aware numerics, drops capacity report aggregate rows (rule = "drop_capacity_aggregate"), filters Debugger Trace noise. applications_reconcile() partitions every input row one four buckets — (renewal exact-match), B (renewal fuzzy-recovered ≥ threshold), C (new fuzzy-matched existing classroom), D (truly new) — using Jaro-Winkler similarity blocked county. Every fuzzy decision plus three runner-candidates logged $reconciliation_log (audit chain, decision_source, decision_timestamp, decision_seed, candidate_classroom_code, candidate_site_code, candidate_rank, score_margin). applications_validate() runs 18 base data-contract checks across four input kinds reconciled objects, plus linkage-specific checks classroom joins, unmatched buckets, row-lineage retention, diagnostic conservation. Validation uses structured ERROR / WARN / INFO severity, row-level $issues accumulation, fixture-backed regression tests. applications_transform() adds data-layer derived variables (is_renewal, is_new, cycle_year_std, applied_this_cycle, tier_prev_dollars, tier_prev_rank, tier_prev_band, capacity_utilization, waitlist_ratio, is_oversubscribed) new alprek_applications_master S3 object. applications_bind_years() stacks multiple cycles alprek_applications_panel preserving applications-grain capacity-grain rows. applications_track_classrooms() summarizes cross-cycle classroom presence. Five export functions: applications_export_csv(), applications_export_parquet(), applications_export_excel(), applications_export_rds(), applications_export_stata(). linkage_applications_classroom() joins applications context onto existing alprek_classroom_panel, preserving row-level lineage, aggregating bucket C new applications matched site, producing alprek_applications_linkage S3 classroom-level rows plus $unmatched_applications slot bucket D rows need downstream geocoding. DuckDB persistence: db_write_applications_master(), db_read_applications_master(), db_write_applications_panel(), db_read_applications_panel(). Adds six new DuckDB tables (applications_clean, applications_capacity, applications_panel, applications_capacity_panel, applications_lineage, applications_derived_log) share existing _alprek_column_types registry. alprek_synthetic_applications() generates synthetic 4-kind ADECE applications input vignettes, examples, tests using fake-code conventions synthetic generators. New codebooks inst/extdata/codebooks/: applications_source_manifest.csv, applications_status_codes.csv (extended release 2026 - 2027 First Class Pre-K New Classroom Application - Round 2 2026-27 First Class Pre-K New Classroom), applications_funding_types.csv (extended New Classroom Funding, Reduced Enrollment, Classroom Funding;Supplemental Funding), applications_edge_cases.csv (17 documented edge cases). R/utils-provenance.R: alprek_file_hash(), alprek_git_sha(), alprek_provenance_record(), internal .alprek_lineage_id() — shared provenance helpers used applications module. Application-specific tests cover validation, transform, panel, export, linkage, DuckDB persistence, env-gated real-data smoke paths across seven test files (test-applications-validate.R, test-applications-transform.R, test-applications-panel.R, test-applications-export.R, test-applications-linkage.R, test-applications-duckdb.R, test-realdata-integration.R).
